claim: A snapshot taken at an odd moment (PC at an ISR entry, interrupts off, IM 2) is a poor start for a build; take one from the recording instead.

evidence.text: The first snapshot had PC at 0xEEEE, the ISR entry at the title menu, with DI and IM 2.
evidence.quote: PC 0xEEEE = ISR entry (title menu; DI, IM 2, I=0xED, table 0xED00-0xEE00 all 0xEE -> 0xEEEE JP 0xA1CB).
